messages:
nina.partnerships: SolarisAI uploaded co-brand assets for the cloud marketplace listing and a 1-page solution brief. Can we do a quick QA on logos, color accessibility, and the one-line customer highlight by 3pm PT?

jules.design: Skimming now. Their primary logo comes with a drop-shadow rasterized into the PNGs which will break our lockup. Asking for clean SVGs. I'll make a temporary mask for the brief if they don't send one.

harry.marketing: For the hero, their draft is long: 'Redwood and SolarisAI: scalable inference pipelines for enterprise workloads.' Propose two variants: short benefit + conservative. I'll post both.

tess.prod: The brief lists "30% lower latency" but doesn't say workload. Can we change to 'up to 30% lower p95 for conversational workloads' and add a footnote with the test config?

marta.legal: Legal note: need signed co-brand license and customer permission to use the quote. I'll prepare the standard addendum and send to SolarisAI legal. Also suggest adding the hedging line: 'Results may vary. See terms.'

upload-bot: Asset checklist: missing clean SVG, signed license, and contrast check. See https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist.

nina.partnerships: Plan: jules to export temporary lockup and request clean SVG, marta to send addendum, tess to provide suggested phrasing and test caption, harry to A/B headlines. Target marketplace upload Fri if all green.

jules.design: Uploaded a quick inline lockup to Figma: https://figma.com/file/x123/solaris-redwood-temp-lockup. Will swap when Solaris sends clean files.

harry.marketing: Posted two headline variants in thread. Variant A: 'Redwood + SolarisAI — inference that scales.' Variant B: 'Reduce inference cost while improving p95.' Preference A for meta title.

tess.prod: I'll pull p95 numbers and an abbreviated test note: 'Test harness: 8xA100, model=redwood-small, batch=8, dataset=conveval-v2.'

marta.legal: Sending addendum now. Will update when signed.

nina.partnerships: Thanks team. If any blockers, DM me. /remind me to follow up Thu 9am.
